title: The Shop Delivers Rectangles

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Next customer.
directions: [board: Click sits behind a very small window with a rubber stamp. One crate waits on the counter. Pip is first in the queue, holding a rolled star map. Board unchanged.]

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: One delivery, please. Star-shaped zone. Very festive.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: The shop delivers rectangles.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Fine. I will fold the points in. The logo stays.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Last time we stood on one square, and the square paid us.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Bank: four crystals. Nobody has spent them yet.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: The Place step comes before movement and attacks. Watch the shaded box. A box is a rectangle.
directions: [board: White Place phase. Bank 4. White Muju on D4. Black Hi on H8. The rectangle A1 through D4 shades in softly, edges included. C3 is empty and highlighted.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: It runs from our home at A one to our Muju at D four, edges included.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: That Muju is our anchor: the friend the box is drawn to. The box is its rectangle.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Column C, row three: empty. Column C, row three: inside the box.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Three crystals buy a Hi there. Only the smallest pieces are for sale.
directions: [sfx: shop chime] [board: a White Hi appears on C3. Bank ticks 4 to 2.]
[card: FOR SALE: the smallest piece of each element]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: It arrives right now. Buying costs crystals and no actions.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: One enemy anywhere inside turns the whole box off. Not only the squares beside it.
directions: [sfx: blocked, gentle] [board: DEMO. A second box shades in, from a home corner out to a different friend. One enemy steps into a far corner of it, nowhere near the friend. The whole box goes dark.]

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: The longest point of my star lands on G seven, outside our box.
directions: [board: back to the real board. Pip's star map is laid over it. Its longest point lands on G7, far outside the shaded box, and G7 dims.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: New puzzle. The bank has four crystals again.
directions: [board: reset. Bank back to 4, the new Hi gone. A Black Hi now stands on B2, inside the shaded box. C3 is still empty and still highlighted.]
[card: CARD ONE: DELIVER TO C THREE · CARD TWO: NOT FROM THIS ANCHOR]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: C three is still empty. A Black Hi is standing on B two, inside our box.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Can that anchor deliver a teammate to C three?

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Put a finger on a card, or look at both.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: The answer is no, and the reason is a good one.
directions: [board: a crate slides out toward C3, reaches the edge of the shaded box, and the whole box goes dark. The crate slides back to the shop. C3 stays empty and stays highlighted.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: The square was fine. The whole box went dark.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: One enemy inside, and the whole box goes dark.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: One rectangle is blocked. A different friend might still have a clear one.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: One complaint and the whole delivery zone closes?

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: That was not a customer.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Name for the file: the Blocked Rectangle.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Now suppose we remove that Black Hi during our actions.
directions: [card: EVIDENCE. Proves: this anchor's rectangle is blocked. Not checked: our other friends, and what Black does next.]
[board: the turn strip. PLACE lights, then ACTION lights, and a shop shutter rolls down over the little window.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Shopping is still finished. Once the turn moves to actions, the shutter comes down.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: My mat says DELIVERY ENTRANCE. It is now a mat outside a shut shop.
directions: [board: Pip lays a felt mat beside D4 and letters it DELIVERY ENTRANCE. The box behind it stays dark.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Cover the box from home to your friend with your hand, edges and all.
directions: [card: MISSION: ONE PURCHASE. THE PRICE, THEN THE SQUARE.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Fire and Lightning cost three each. Water and Shadow cost four. Plant and Metal cost five. You may buy any number you can afford, on legal empty squares. Each new piece can act immediately.

supplement.title: The tier-one shop
supplement.body:
Hi / Radi: 3 crystals
Sjor / Göl: 4 crystals
Muju / Inyan: 5 crystals
Buy any affordable number. New pieces act now.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Black draws rectangles from J ten toward a Black anchor. Either player may choose any clear friendly anchor. An enemy on your home is inside every one of your rectangles, so it blocks all purchases. Existing pieces can still promote and act.

supplement.title: Both players use their own home
supplement.body:
White: A1 → friendly anchor
Black: J10 → friendly anchor
An enemy on your home blocks every purchase rectangle.
Existing pieces can still promote, move and attack.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: If an enemy is under your hand, pick another friend. Stopping here is fine.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: The star map goes in the drawer. The logo was finished first.

question: Can that anchor deliver a teammate to C three?
